text: If everything in your life is falling apart right now, congratulations!
And in thirty seconds, you'll understand why.
The job that drains you every morning.
But here's what nobody tells you.
Whatever fills that space depends on what you do in the next few days.
Empty space doesn't stay empty for long.
And the cards have a name for this exact moment.
But the card that comes right after it is the one everyone prays for!
Comment claim, tap my profile picture, and pull your three cards in my Stories before this year closes.
Don't stop at the half that hurts.
